title: TrueVault | Can I charge for a data subject request?
summary: Learn more about Data Subject Requests, including timelines and acceptable fees, with our FAQS about GDPR.
body_markdown:
[Article 15.3](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-15-gdpr/) of[GDPR](https://www.truevault.com/solutions/gdpr) states that the first copy of a data subject access request (DSAR) should be provided to the data subject free of charge. However, if the data subject requests subsequent copies of a DSAR, your company can charge a reasonable fee. This fee should be based on the administrative costs of complying with the request.


If the data subject complains to the supervisory authority about being charged for a DSAR (which is within the rights of a data subject) then the burden is on your company to prove that the fee assessment was fair. Learn more about what GDPR says about[data subject access requests (DSARs)](https://www.truevault.com/blog/responding-to-data-subject-requests) here and download our GDPR Guide to learn more.
